name: ZX902-AF-42N(EN).pdf
text:
[p1]
Datasheet
6-Port 100Mbps PoE Switch
Product Highlights
n 4 *100Mbps PoE ports+2 *100Mbps uplink RJ45 ports
n Complies with IEEE 802.3, IEEE 802.3u, and IEEE 802.3x standards
n RJ45 port supports 10/100Mbps adaptive
n The PoE port automatically turns on the PoE watchdog mode in VLAN and extended modes.
n Flow control method: Full duplex uses IEEE 802.3x standard, while half duplex uses Back
pressure standard
n Supports automatic port flipping (Auto MDI/MDIX)
n Adopting a storage and forwarding exchange mechanism
n The panel indicator LED will monitor the working status and assist in fault analysis
n Supports VLAN, OFF, Extend, three modes
n Port 1 supports HiPoE 60W
